author: Mark Atwood
text: Second independent review found the oracle-gap class again and added two more required vector types: (1) tail-discard class — a pubkey whose inverted form has >=144 leading 1 bits, where remaining bits < 112 and the trailing partial byte is DISCARDED (not zero-padded); spec §8.5/§8.7 prose has been corrected to upstream's whole-byte-pack/discard semantics (this matters: e.g. inverted remainder 11111 -> upstream yields 0 whole bytes, wrong prose yields 0xf8); (2) a SubnetForKey vector covering 0300::/8. All new vectors must be generated from upstream yggdrasil-go commit 422836ee src/address/address.go via an independent implementation, never from LICHEN code under test.
